title: Geometry Optimization of ZOV Structures
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization of the Zn2(OH)VO4 and Zn3(OH)VO4 unit cells using GGA-PBE to obtain relaxed atomic positions for the subsequent CI-NEB calculation.
description: Relax the end-point structures to their equilibrium geometry. The optimized coordinates are used as input for the next step.

title: NEB Barrier Calculation for D1 Pathway
action: Using the optimized structures, run a climbing-image nudged elastic band (CI-NEB) calculation for Zn2+ migration between Zn0 and Zn1 sites along pathway D1. Extract the minimum energy barrier in eV and write the result to step_01_barrier.csv.
description: Computed Zn2+ migration energy barrier for pathway D1 in ZOV.
output_schema: CSV with columns: pathway (string), barrier_eV (float). Must contain one row for pathway 'D1' with the computed barrier.
